subject: science

applicable_programme.grade_mapping_note: PYP covers ages 3-12; our Grade 3 mapping (typically age 8-9) is within the programme but is our convention, not an IB-specified grade boundary.

grade_specific_note.label: C
grade_specific_note.text: Grade 3 students in PYP science engage with inquiry into living things, materials, forces, and Earth systems, typically within transdisciplinary units that connect science to broader themes.

subject_group_or_structure.mapping_to_primer_subject: PYP does not have a standalone 'Science' subject; scientific concepts are explored through the transdisciplinary themes, particularly 'How the world works' and 'Sharing the planet'. This maps to our Science subject.

concepts: Causation - Why is it like it is?
Connection - How is it connected to other things?
Perspective - What are the points of view?
global_contexts_or_transdisciplinary_the: Where we are in place and time

official_requirements.label: B
official_requirements.text: PYP Science Scope and Sequence covers four strands: Living things, Earth and space, Materials and matter, and Forces and energy.

official_requirements.label: B
official_requirements.text: Scientific inquiry in PYP develops through exploration, investigation, and communication phases, emphasizing the process of scientific thinking.

official_requirements.label: B
official_requirements.text: Science is typically embedded within units of inquiry under transdisciplinary themes, especially 'How the world works' and 'Sharing the planet'.

typical_fit.label: C
typical_fit.text: At Grade 3, PYP science learners typically: explore properties of matter and states of matter, investigate forces including gravity, observe and classify living things, and understand Earth's place in space. These align with Florida NGSSS standards for physical science (SC.3.P), life science (SC.3.L), and earth/space science (SC.3.E).

suggested_alignment_to_florida_and_arizo.label: C

florida.alignment_note: Scientific inquiry aligns strongly with PYP inquiry approach and research skills.
Properties of matter aligns with PYP Materials and matter strand.
Gravity exploration aligns with PYP Forces and energy strand.
Animal classification aligns with PYP Living things strand.
Sun as energy source aligns with PYP Earth and space strand.

suggested_alignment_to_florida_and_arizo.notes: Arizona standards deferred. These alignments are suggested starting points (Label C), not official IB-Florida mappings.
